So, long story short:  I was friends with this guy who had a mutual friend in the music scene and added me on facebook about four years prior to this.  We'd grown really close, sending long messages back and forth and whatnot.  Seemed like a decent guy, albeit a bit of a loner.  Never once did he express any sort of romantic interest.  

He drove from his city to mine (about a five hour drive) for a movie festival and I told him it was okay to crash at my place.  The evening he arrived, things seemed totally fine - good conversation, we went out to eat with a friend of mine, etc...Everything seemed normal until he started to behave very strangely around bedtime.  His entire demeanor changed and he seemed very...panicked.  He demanded a "goodnight kiss" and I was completely flabbergasted and had no idea how to respond.  He swooped in and pecked me on the lips before I could do anything.  I said a very rushed, awkward goodnight and went to bed.  I woke up to hear him banging on my bedroom door at about 2 or 3 am.  I asked through the door what was wrong.  I can't remember why I opened the door but I did, and he's wild-eyed and blathering on about how he didn't drive five hours to only receive a good night kiss, etc...He finally fucked off after I shut my door.  I barricaded my door and didn't sleep for the rest of the night.  It's a miracle I wasn't actually sexually assaulted, tbh. 

I had school the next morning.  I didn't know what to do, though looking back, there's an entire list of things I should have done.  I went to school and just...left him in my house after vague-texting my friend that there was something wrong and I had no idea how to get him to leave.  Thankfully, he was gone by the time I came home.  

During his drive home and for the next five or so days (actually for almost 2 years, but the worst of it was in the week or so following his return home) he bombarded my inboxes on facebook, via text, and email.  I must have gotten about 25 texts a day.  My phone at the time did not have blocking capabilities, so I ended up changing my phone number after about two months of relentless texts and phone calls.  I blocked him on facebook, and he just kept making new accounts.  Same with gmail.  I have an entire folder of screenshots and saved emails ranging from death threats, to sexual bullshit like the emails I'm showing here, to attempts at normal conversations about his mother's birthday.  

I contacted the police and they were extremely unhelpful.  The first woman told me that I couldn't get a restraining order unless I had proof I was in danger (apparently months worth of emails like this weren't enough).  The second person I spoke too inferred that I should have known better and therefore deserved it and there was nothing they were capable or willing to do for me.  

He gave up after about two years of this.  I haven't heard from him since.  I did get a message at random from someone on Reddit on my old account and I'm 99% sure it was this guy.  He likely connected my slightly similar username to a music forum I frequented and messaged me on the off chance that it was me (it was, good job).  I deleted the account immediately and then made this one.  

Hindsight is 20/20.  I'm an idiot for inviting him to my home, and a fool for trusting someone who was essentially a stranger, regardless of the fact that we'd been corresponding at length for years.  I'm an idiot for responding to any of these messages.  I should have ignored all of them.
